反日恐怖分子袭击租界内的学校

反日恐怖分子暗杀了上海女子大学校长以及台海中学（音译）校长，此二人曾为适应当前局势教育中国儿童和青年而改变了其反日教育政策。
9月13日上午，约40名暴徒乘两辆卡车抵达康纳路（Connaught Road）359号的光时中学（音译）。其中一人向一名苦力要求面见浙西大学（音译）校长。苦力回答说校长尚未到校，随即这40名暴徒全部进入大学，殴打该苦力直至其失去知觉，并砸毁了办公室、教室、家具和窗玻璃。停留约8分钟后，他们携带一些文件离去。
该校校长胡世增博士（音译）因改变教育政策以适应新形势，一直与某些方面保持密切联系。因此，他被国民党开除。
据信，对该大学的袭击是由反日恐怖分子唆使的苦力所为，这些恐怖分子系奉重庆政府指令行动。幸运的是，由于袭击发生在清晨，校长和教师尚未到校，无人受伤。

THE MURDER OF DR. WOO TS-CHI

General Chiang Kai-shek has sent the following
instructions to Chen Ko-fu, Minister of Education of the
National Government :-
"According to newspaper reports, Dr. Woo
Ts-chi(吴志), President of the Shanghai University
for Girls, was assassinated because he had refused to
co-operate with the rebels.
"Shanghai is now overrun by the enemy and their
puppets. Violent acts have frequently taken place.
This educationalist who did not yield to threats should
be praised and respected; he should be regarded as a
model to all educationalists. I highly respect him for
having sacrificed his life for the righteous cause and
hope that you will conduct a through investigation into
the assassination. Also send on my behalf a telegram
to the family of the victim for condolence and to pacify
the soul of the victim."

吴志奇博士遇害案

蒋介石将军已向国民政府教育部长陈果夫发出如下指示：
“据报纸报道，上海女子大学校长吴志奇（吴志）博士因拒绝与叛逆合作而遭暗杀。
“上海目前已被敌人及其傀儡充斥。暴力行为屡有发生。这位不屈服于威胁的教育家值得赞扬和尊敬；他应被视为所有教育工作者的楷模。我高度敬重他为正义事业牺牲生命，希望你对此暗杀案进行彻底调查。并代表我向受害者家属发送唁电，以慰逝者在天之灵。”

In Appreciation

To the Editor of the Chinese-American Daily News,
The assassination of Mr. Woo Ts-chi, President
of the Shanghai University for Girls, on the ground that
he was anti-Wang Ching-wei, is a great misfortune to
educational circles.
Ever since Wang Ching-wei issued his shameless
and ridiculous peace proposals, no descendant of Hwang Ti
has not been indignant. Yet Wang is still unrepentant.
Wang is begging mercy from Japan while internally he is
threatening and seducing the persons loyal to the national
government. However, Mr. Woo Ts-chi stood firmly to
his attitude and was assassinated.

We hereby send you $20 as a donation which
please forward to the family of the deceased. We also hope
that members of educational circles throughout Shanghai
will firmly adhere to the last in the spirit that "our
head may be broken but our spirit can never be bent."
Chang Chung-ze (張忠如),
Voong Zah-sien (馮若先),
Chin Fee-mei (金非楣),
Koo Che-wu (顧計元).

At 10a.m. 7-9-39 Foo Yih Ts, brother of deceased brought to the station a letter which he had received by post at 8.a.m. 7-9-39, a translation reads as follows:-

Mr. Yih Tu
I am deeply regretful regarding the assassination of your brother "Mr. Ts Chih" who was unwilling to surrender himself to the traitors.
I beg to inform you that one named Yang Hwa Sung, who is a leader of a criminal gang, and has numerous comrades some of whom are named Siau Kyi Koo, "Zung Tuh Mo Bee" and Yang Zung Fu etc. They are responsible for the assassination of enthusiasts. Yang is residing in an upstairs room above Lane 7 (Tuh n Li) Bung Tong Loong Jao (North of Bridge). In view of this, I lay this information before you with the hope that you will pass the information to the Police enabling them to effect the arrest of the above mentioned persons and will to come to negotiate with you later.
A report to the above effect has also been made to West Hongkew Station.
Signed:- Wong Tuh Meu.

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

An inquest was held on the body of Woo Ts Chih at the Public Mortuary, Kiaochow Park at 10 a.m. 5-9-39.

Upon all evidence being presented the following verdict was given:-

"Death due to bullet wounds. Body to be removed by his brother Woo Yih Ts. Police to continue enquiries as to the persons responsible."

With regard to the statement of Woo Yih Ts at the inquest that a young person had pretended to enroll as a student, he when questioned about this, stated that his brother while lying in Hospital just prior to his death mentioned something vague about some person who attempted to enroll but he was unable to give any particulars of this and enquiries from the students and employees of the school failed to obtain any corroboration.

The body was taken away by the brother and a funeral is being held on 6-9-39 at which, all the students of the school will be present.

C.D.S. 66 and 254 have continued enquiries in the vicinity of the school but they have been unable to ascertain whether the 3 persons responsible for the crime left on foot or by a motor car.

At 8.48a.m. 4-9-39, a telephone message was
received from the Shanghai Girls' University, 451
Taku Road, stating that the Principal Woo Ts Chih
(吴志希) had been shot. The S.F.B. ambulance was
called and the man conveyed to the Shanghai Sanita-
rium and Clinic, 526 B'Well Road, from where the
Doctor's certificate was issued:-

"Penetrating bullet wounds of arm, chest
and abdomen. Brought in in shock. Condition
serious."

Upon receipt of the initial report a party of
Police attended the scene but it was found that
the assailants had decamped prior to the report
being made to the station.

Enquiries by D. I. Hill, D. I. Lau Ching Van,
C.D.S.s 26, and 254 and the undersigned show that
the scene of the crime is a large building standing
in its own grounds on Taku Road between Chengtu
Road and Yates Road. The main entrance is on Taku
Road, at which there is a private watchman (unnamed)
Tu Kya Hsiang (儲嘉祥). The actual scene of the
crime is an office situated at the rear of the
building.

From an interrogation of witnesses the
following facts were ascertained:-

At 7a.m. 4-9-39 a gateman Wong Tuk Sien (王德先)
as is his usual custom, opened the front gates for
the entry of students.

At about 8.30a.m. 4-9-39 a male Chinese, dressed
in foreign style clothing entered the open gate.

1939年9月4日上午8时48分，接到大沽路451号上海女子大学的电话消息，称校长吴志希 (Woo Ts Chih)〔注：此处英文拼写与上文吴志斋略有不同，依原文译出〕遭枪击。遂呼叫市卫生局 (S.F.B.) 救护车，将该男子送往倍开尔路526号上海疗养院及诊所 (Shanghai Sanitarium and Clinic)，医生出具证明如下：

“手臂、胸部及腹部有穿透性枪弹伤。送医时处于休克状态。病情危重。”

接到初步报告后，一队警察赶赴现场，但发现袭击者在向捕房报案前已逃窜。

经警探希尔 (D. I. Hill)、警探刘清云 (D. I. Lau Ching Van)、华籍侦探社警员 (C.D.S.s) 26号和254号以及具名人的查询显示，犯罪现场位于大沽路成都路与耶茨路 (Yates Road) 之间的一座独立大院内的庞大建筑。正门位于大沽路，门口有一名私人看守（姓名不详）储嘉祥 (Tu Kya Hsiang)。实际犯罪现场是位于该建筑后方的一间办公室。

通过对证人的讯问，查明了以下事实：

1939年9月4日上午7时，看门人王德先 (Wong Tuk Sien) 按惯例打开前门供学生进入。

1939年9月4日上午8时30分左右，一名身穿西式服装的中国男性进入敞开的大门。

also entered the gate and each presenting a pistol

mausers), told the watchman to keep quiet and ordered

second two armed men stood guard over the watchman while
the Chinese dressed in a foreign suit, proceeded up the
main path and turned into the rear of the university. He
then entered a rear door which gives access to the
teachers' recreation rooms, and finding the Principal
Woo Ts Chih, sitting in the teachers' refreshment room
shot at him with a pistol. Woo Ts Chih picked up a
chair and attempting to defend himself advanced on the
intruder. The latter backed away and then taking up a
position near a door leading to a courtyard took deli-
berate aim at Woo and fired several more shots from a
distance of about two yards. Woo then fell to the
ground. The assailant made off through the courtyard
and through the school building to the main gate, where
along with his two accomplices he left, going in an
unknown direction.

During the actual shooting of Wee Te Chih, the
students of the school attempted to run out of the
front gate but one of the armed men at the gate stopped
them by firing one round at the ground.

An inspection of the scene resulted in the finding
of 7 empty cartridge cases and 2 spent rounds near the
scene of the actual shooting and one empty cartridge
case near the entrance gate. These were sent to the
Arms Identification Section for examination. Finger
prints left by the assassin on a doorpost while he was
taking aim at the victim were examined by D.S. Kent
of the Finger Print Bureau, who attended the scene and
took photographs, his report is omitted.

Detectives proceeded to the Hospital with the
intention of interrogating the victim but his condition
did not allow this, he died at 11.30 a.m. 4/2/59 without
giving any information that would assist in the
investigation.

Extensive enquiries by detectives in the vicinity
of the gate on Tuku Road among the neighbouring shop-
keepers failed to locate any witness of the departure
of the three men.

警探前往医院意图讯问受害者，但其身体状况不允许，他于1959年2月4日上午11时30分死亡〔注：原文年份1959显然为OCR错误或笔误，应为1939，但按要求照实译出〕，未提供任何有助于调查的信息。

Pan Kou Zai, age 47, native of Tungchow, M/teacher,
residing at 451 Taku Road, The Shanghai Girls' College.
I have been employed as a teacher of the said school
for over two years. At about 8.30a.m. on 4-9-39 when I was
checking composition made by students, in my office, I
suddenly heard the sound of pistol shots, and simultaneously
I noticed a person in foreign dress, standing beside a desk
in the teachers' refreshment-room, where he fired other two
shots in succession, at the Principal Woo Ts Chih. At this
moment the school fell into disorder, and I then ran out
from my office to a place on the drill-ground. After an
interval of about 1 or 2 minutes, the described person who
was armed with a pistol, left through the side door and
made good his escape through the main entrance. When he
reached the main door, he concealed his pistol in his clothing.
I then went to the teachers' refreshment-room in which I
observed painter Lee Tsien Sung holding Mr. Woo up. Being
aware that he had been wounded, I immediately rang up the
Police station to make a report. The injured principal was
later sent to a hospital whilst I attended the station.
The above is my true statement.
Signed.

September 4, 1939. Afternoon Translation.

China Evening News (Noon Edition) :-

WOO TS-CHI, PRESIDENT OF THE SHANGHAI UNIVERSITY FOR GIRLS,
ATTACKED AND SERIOUSLY WOUNDED

At 8.50 a.m. to-day, a sensational case
of attempted murder occurred in the premises occupied
jointly by the Shanghai University for Girls, the Shanghai
Middle School for Girls and the Shanghai Primary School
for Girls, at No. 451 Yates Road corner of Taku Road, the
victim being Woo Ts-chi ( 吴子馨 ), the President of these
schools.

FILE

It appears that at the time, several
young men armed with pistols and dressed in clothing of
various kinds, style and colour, broke into the office
of the university and fired at Woo Ts-chi. In all six
shots were fired and Woo was hit by three bullets in the
chest and stomach. He at once fell to the floor and bled
profusely. At the time of the shooting, a large number
of students were present; they became greatly frightened
and all ran for safety, thereby causing much confusion,
in the course of which the gunmen leisurely retreated
outside the school premises with their weapons and made
good their escape.

The injured man was later conveyed to
hospital for treatment in an ambulance called by the Police.
As he was seriously injured, his life is said to be in
danger. For full details, please read the evening edition
of this paper at 4 p.m.

《中国晚报》（午版）：-

圣玛利亚女中校长吴子馨遇袭重伤

今日上午8时50分，在位于大沽路451号与塔古路（Taku Road，即大沽路）转角、由圣玛利亚女中、圣玛利亚女中和圣玛利亚女小共同使用的校舍内，发生了一起轰动的谋杀未遂案，受害者为这些学校的校长吴子馨（Woo Ts-chi）。

档案

据悉，当时几名手持手枪、身着各式颜色服装的青年男子闯入大学办公室，向吴子馨开枪。总共开了六枪，吴胸部和腹部中三弹。他随即倒地，大量出血。枪击发生时，现场有大量学生；他们极度惊恐，纷纷逃命，造成极大混乱，枪手借此从容持械退出校舍并成功逃脱。

伤者随后由警方叫来的救护车送往医院救治。由于伤势严重，据说生命垂危。详情敬请阅读本报下午4时的晚版。

这位教育家被送往静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）的上海疗养院医院及诊所（Shanghai Sanitarium Hospital and Clinic），医生准备了输血并对四处伤口进行了手术，两处位于手臂，一处在胸部，另一处在腹部。

同伙

当他的四名同伙在入口处等候时，这名身穿西式服装的枪手假装索取学校目录混入校内。走进行政办公室后，他在大厅遇到了校长。甚至未发一言，枪手便拔出大型军用毛瑟手枪，连开六七枪。在警报响起之前，他便已逃脱。

吴先生于上午9时由消防队救护车送往医院，但于11时30分死亡。成都路巡捕房警员正在调查此案。

With reference to the assassination of Wu Tse
Chien, principal of the Shanghai Girls' University,
451 Taku Road, in the institute on September 4, 1939,
it has been learned that the crime was instigated by
the pro-Wang Ching Wei clique as a punishment for
Wu's stubborn and insolent attitude towards Wang
Ching Wei, the deposed Vice-Executive of the
Kuomintang.

The deceased, Wu Tse Chien, aged 36, a native
of Tungchow, is a returned student from Italy and
the sole promoter of the Shanghai Girls Middle School,
Nantao, which was later transferred and renamed the
Shanghai Girls' University in 1937 immediately after
the outbreak of the Sino-Japanese hostilities in
Shanghai. He also sponsored a number of local
educational societies, including:-

Society, 6/152 Chengtu Road.

3. Shanghai New Universities Association, 451 Taku
Road.
4. Shanghai Supplementary Education Association,
Room 204, 210 Kiukiang Road.
5. Federation of Chinese Students Returned from
Abroad, with a communication address c/o
451 Taku Road.

The record of this office shows that he took a very
